drafter.message_to_opposing_counsel:
Thank you for flagging the inadvertently included internal client note and for refraining from using or disseminating it. Please sequester the prior file and any extracts or copies pending resolution, and confirm whether it was shared further. We request its return or deletion, subject to any applicable preservation obligations and clawback procedure, and reserve all applicable privilege and protection claims. We will provide a sanitized replacement.

We agree that the responses should identify objections and withholding on a request-by-request basis. We are finalizing those responses following verification of the individual requests and collection status; we will not rely on blanket objections. We propose serving the amended responses within seven calendar days of your confirmation, beginning production within fourteen calendar days, and completing production within thirty calendar days of that confirmation. Please confirm those dates. We propose a privilege log within fourteen calendar days after substantial completion, in searchable spreadsheet format identifying the request number, document date and type, author, recipients and their roles, a nonprivileged description, and the privilege or protection asserted. Any categorical treatment would require agreement or authorization under applicable rules.

edits.text: 1. OBJECTIONS. Any objection will be stated in the response to the particular request, with its specific basis and a statement whether responsive materials are being withheld on that basis. Defendant does not assert a blanket privilege objection to all requests.

2. PRODUCTION. Defendant will produce responsive, nonprivileged documents within its possession, custody, or control. Each request-specific response will identify the scope of production and whether responsive materials are being withheld on an asserted objection. The parties' proposed production schedule remains subject to confirmation.

3. PRIVILEGE LOG. For responsive materials withheld on privilege or protection grounds, Defendant proposes providing a searchable spreadsheet log within fourteen calendar days after substantial completion of production. The log will identify the applicable request number, document date and type, author, recipients and their roles, a description sufficient to assess the claim without revealing protected information, and the privilege or protection asserted. Any exclusions or categorical logging will be governed by applicable rules, court order, or agreement.
